reviews.comment: Professor Wu cares about his students, but I found the lectures hard to follow and test reviews did not closely aligned with exams. I relied more on review materials and slides to study. Homework and quizzes help your grade, but exams are challenging. The first average was around a 70, and I found the final especially difficult.

Professor Wu was a great teacher. I found it far more effective to miss class and cram study topics than to regularly attend lectures, as sometimes lectures were bogged down with information that felt irrelevant or overly complex.
Overall, this course is designed well and is accessible to all different learning styles. Exams are graded forgivingly.

Professor Wu truly cares about his students; he always responds to emails at random hours and is genuinely helpful with his responses. He is very passionate about his teaching, and the lectures reflect that. If you understood 341, you'll do fine in this class. Has reviews for his exams, if you know how to do them you'll be fine.

Wei Wu is the GOAT. Very interesting lectures and he makes the class content very understandable. Very funny guy who is super chill outside of class. Ran into him at CFA and he remembered who I was from class and was super nice. Gives great practice content for his exams and if you study and complete the work its easy to get an A or B.
Dr. Wu is extremely intelligent and a great professor. His lectures are fun, interesting, and he's a very animated guy. Exams are heavily based on the practice exams. I highly encourage taking Wu!

Tough class, prof is decent. Pretty funny, in my experience the exams are just rewritten versions of the practice tests which is huge. Homework can be a pain sometimes but is honestly way harder than what you're tested on. Shouldn't be terrible as long as you're going to class and applying yourself.

Great professor for 361! He explains the material very thoroughly and in a manner that is easy to understand while connecting ideas. He is great at answering questions and is very knowledgeable about the material he teaches. He can be quite funny and tries to make his lectures dynamic. Put in effort and you'll do great!

Favorite professor I ever had at TAMU for sure. Great lectures engages class. Really cares about students understanding and applying the material. Sometimes he is pretty comical too! If you do the work and study hard you can get an A for sure in 361.

What an absolute legend. Do the practice exams, and when taking the exams be as specific as possible because this guy is always looking to give partial credit. Very obvious that he wants his students to pass.

Wu is nice and he teaches moderately well. Definitely slow and boring lectures, but that's hard to avoid. The exams are completely open ended questions and are tough, but he gives good partial credit. Grade makeup is 15% hw, 15% quizzes. 20% exam 1, 20% exam 2, 30% final comprehensive exam. This class is tough, but not as tough as FINC351.

You can tell he tries to make it entertaining, but the lectures get very dry. I would suggest going to class to make the HWs and quizzes easier for you. Also, the practice exams are very helpful resources to use prior to taking the exams. Overall not terribly difficult, but can be boring at times and you will be confused if you do not go to class.

He is really nice and gives A LOT of partial credit on tests. I should have failed a test but I got a C because he's the best.

However, he has a really thick accent, so if you have trouble understanding accents, he may not be a good teacher for you. I have ADHD with auditory processing issues, so it can be difficult to understand his lectures.

Wei is a really nice guy; I just really struggled in his class. His tests can get difficult, especially if you have a heavy course load in that semester and can't study as much. I found his lectures to be unclear, even after rewatching them. He's very accessible outside of class! Just don't take ACCT327 and FINC351 in the same semester like I did.

Professor Wu was an awesome teacher. I wish he would had changed his tests from period to period because it was unfortunate to see so much cheating happen. Classes that took the tests at 8am had the opportunity to give students almost 2 hours to prepare and get 100's on the exam later on in the day. The same thing happened with the final.

He's a really nice professor. If you're confused, he will do his best to answer questions in class. Just raise your hand. As for the exams, they start out easy, but if you have a heavy course load, you might want to watch out towards the end. Homework is online, you have to buy a key, and random attendance quizzes throughout. Take notes in class!

Overall a good professor but the exams are all free response and very little partial credit is given. The exams also can have the most random things mentioned in class, so make sure you know everything from class. Do the practice exams a couple of times and review the homework and you'll be fine. PS: Don't take ACCT 327 in the same semester.

Nice guy but his tests are awful. He says we aren't responsible for anything not covered in class but he will mention a word once for a split second and expect you to know every detail about it for the test. Tests are all open ended and very vague but he is looking for very specific answers. It is nearly impossible to know what exactly he is asking
